ValidationRule.description: Restrict users from updating Declined status to EP Review Done
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND (ISCHANGED( Status__c ), OR(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Status__c))="Declined", TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Status__c))="NF Decline"), TEXT(Status__c)="EP Review Done", $Setup.ValidationRules__c.Update_Declined_CR_Status__c =FALSE)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: User do not have access to update Credit Review status from Declined to EP Review Done.
